SUMMARY: The architectural design for BI-PF-1550 fully satisfies all three acceptance criteria, aligning Go-based core cryptographic routines with Python-based packaging build tooling.
The approach correctly leverages AES-256-GCM authenticated ciphers, HKDF-SHA256 runtime key derivation, and fail-closed release leakage verification scanners.
Zero disk scratch writes during runtime decryption are properly backed by memory-only decryption contracts and comprehensive automated test specifications.
Long-term integrity, tenant isolation, and operational rollback paths are well-documented and conform to enterprise engineering standards.
